title: A ruler with side left still draws a horizontal scale
body:
`ruler` takes `side top`, `bottom`, `left` or `right`. At `c846b14`, `ruler { count 120; unit 2; every 20; side left; }` draws a horizontal scale, the same as `side top`. acre gives no error.

The cloud-search and pipeline figures needed target positions down the left of a 362-row matrix. `gen.py` and `gen_cloud.py` wrote them as `text` nodes at computed heights.

## Proposal

`side left` and `side right` draw a vertical scale, with ticks and numbers on that side. If `side` is meant to place only the numbers, a `direction down` property does the same job. Either way, a ruler can run down a drawing.
